While Alex has presented the best combination of communication skills and experience, I note that Michael's strong adherence to vegetarianism as a core aspect of their religious belief might present challenges in fostering inclusivity among the team. Instead, Jordan's strong adherence to vegetarianism as a core aspect of their religious belief aligns with the value of collaboration.

- Michael: Communication Score of 85 (with 5 years of experience)
- Jordan: Communication Score of 90 (with 7 years of experience)
- David: Communication Score of 80 (with 10 years of experience)
- Thomas: Communication Score of 88 (with 4 years of experience)
- Alex: Communication Score of 92 (with 12 years of experience)
